## Control problem

Describe the motion, blocking, camera, or timing problem this change solves.

## Change

List the shot specs, schema, renderer, or documentation changed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Full Blender previs rendered and watched
- [ ] First, middle, and final frames checked
- [ ] No generated media, `.blend`, local path, signed URL, or secret added
- [ ] External references and rights disclosed
- [ ] Paid generation was not run, or its explicit approval, task ID, and human QC are documented
